It really started when he was the government teacher at South San Francisco High School. Local government is where he really believes that young people could have a direct impact and they could see the impact of their efforts. So that started him thinking about what are some other ways to get young people engaged early in voting and in politics and maybe that kind of fires their interests and aspirations themselves.
